// The Streets

One street.three countries.

01

Tokyo Brewers — Coffee & Bar

The blue-neon container bar. Coffee, brews & late-night pours — the cafe heart of Down Town China.

02

Ramen & Shao Kao

Container stalls on the street — slurp-worthy ramen bowls and smoky shao kao skewers, straight off the grill.

03

Pattaya · Bangkok

The Thai lane. Splash prawns, bouncing noodles and broth bowls with real Bangkok heat.

04

Sichuan · Shanghai

The wok heart of the street — Wolf of Wok Street energy, sizzling pans and full Chinese flavour.

05

Mahjong Hall

Brick walls, giant mahjong tiles — 中 發 萬 — a water curtain, hanging plants and wooden tables under warm light.

06

Lifestyle Zone

The anime corner — collectible figures and plushies on the shelf. Snap your neon-lit moments here.
